correctness.rationale: The proof fixes metric normalization sum_j 2^{-|j|}=3. For any iid marginal with support diameter d, the constant midpoint target makes its Bowen ball full measure at and above 3d/2. For any smaller radius, arbitrarily spaced disjoint finite blocks have uniformly positive independent probabilities to approximate the farther support endpoint at each coordinate; Borel-Cantelli forces a shift-time separation a.s. De Finetti, Fubini and a finite cover of support midpoints prove the exact essential-infimum law for all exchangeable mixtures. Singleton-support and zero-diameter cases are handled. Independent rational-arithmetic checker passed.

value.rationale: A complete natural classification of a large dependent invariant-measure class answers exactly when the Hilbert-cube shift has a common positive measure-expansivity radius. It sharpens the first motivating Lebesgue bound from <1/2 to optimal supremum 3/2 and constructs an unexpected full-support invariant atomless law whose every Bernoulli ergodic component is strongly mixing and expansive, while their countable mixture is not. This isolates the geometric invariant (minimum component support width) responsible for loss of expansivity under decomposition.
